newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba Ceramics strengthens on laggard buying.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba Ceramics strengthens on laggard buying.

text.p: Toshiba Ceramics Co Ltd shares strengthened in Friday morning trade as investors sought the issue, which is viewed as a laggard, brokers said.
As of 0132 GMT, the shares were up 40 yen at 1,140.
"The shares were left a little behind in the recent rally and are in the process of catching up," a broker at a "Big Four" brokerage said.

"The EPS based on the group earnings forecast for the year to end-March 1998 calculates to about 51 yen, which is quite attractive," a trader at a middle-sized brokerage said. "Chip-related issues have been sought-after lately, and that trend is also helping to lift the issue."
